title: 第一章：一夜之间
content_zh:
日落西山，宛如山顶的一颗红宝石，映起万丈红霞染红了半边天，明月东升，犹如自九天之上垂下的灯笼，洒下缕缕清辉，与西方的万丈红霞遥相呼应，日月同辉，那是一个传说，如此奇观在华央大陆上只出现过第三次，每次的出现无不是引起了一场龙争虎斗，留下了一段诸神争天的传说。

    就在日月同辉出现的那一刻，华央大陆四洲五海之内，霎时之间，洋溢着不安、激动、兴奋的情绪，在这即将现世的诸神并起的时代里，每个人都想在接下来的传说里留下一道自己的身影；每个人都希望自己能横穿整个时代，逍遥于天地间。

    这是一次莫大的机缘，不知谁能笑到最后？这是一场无尽的杀戮，有谁能挣脱这无边的血海？

    但在这片漫漫无边的大陆之上，并不是所有人都这么在乎这一刻是某一时代的开始亦或是结束，因为有太多的事比起这些无比遥远而又虚无飘渺的事都太过重要，例如，吃饭、穿衣、以及血脉的传承。

    华央大陆武朝远山镇贺府大门之外，围着一圈又一圈的“听喜人”，而府内也早已是一派张灯结彩，虽然只是日暮黄昏，但大红灯笼却是早早的就点亮了起来。

    做过父亲的人都知道，生孩子这种事一向是急不得的，任你在房门外急得团团转，房内仍只是一声声撕心裂肺的呼痛声。

    后院之中，只见老婆子小丫鬟来去匆忙，但却不显慌乱喧闹，可见平时管教却是极严，只是这时自房屋内又传来了一声惨叫声，这可急坏了在门外不知转了多少圈的贺烈，时而背负双手，时而拳掌相击，一张棱角分明，充满阳刚之气的的脸庞上尽是细密的汗珠，不时向屋内张望，虽然他没有生过孩子，但他却知道生孩子完全就是一场毫无胜算的与天争命，争得不只是大人的命，还有小孩的。

    满眼看着进进出出的不停忙碌的人，嘴里不停地嘀咕着：你们这些人跑来跑去的到底都在忙什么呢？里面到底怎么样了，怎么还没生出来？老子当初下种的时候也没用这么长的时间啊。

    就在贺烈实在忍不住想要进去看看情况的时候，出来一个老妈子，朝着贺烈这边疾行而来，贺烈见这情形哪里还不知道是找自己的？赶忙快不赶上，不带她开口说话，急忙说道：“生了？”老婆子急忙摇了摇头，正要说话，却看到贺烈一脸的痛苦之色，双眼瞬间赤红，紧握着拳头，低吼道：“保大！快！快去啊！”

    就在这时，屋里传来一道婴孩的啼哭声，贺烈愣愣的听着屋内传来的婴孩的大哭声，他很怀疑自己是不是听错了，因为他就听到一声哭声。直到看到从屋内跑出一人对着他大声喊道：“老爷，生了，是个少爷”

    随后便是一片恭喜之声，贺喜之语，这时他才醒悟，原来刚才这人是来“闻喜报信”的，就像是府内上下，虽然孩子还没有出生，但是大红灯笼却是早已高高挂起，府内到处贴满“喜”字，这叫“报喜”图个喜庆，也图个吉利，只是自己心神激荡之下，失了分寸，不禁大感尴尬，大喝一声：“赏，所有人统统有赏”。
content_en:
The sunset on the west mountain is like a ruby ​​on the top of the mountain, reflecting the thousands of feet of red clouds that dye half of the sky red. The bright moon rises in the east, like a lantern hanging from the nine heavens, shedding wisps of clear light, echoing the thousands of feet of red clouds in the west. The sun and the moon shine together. It is a legend. Such a spectacle has only appeared for the third time in Huayang Continent. Each time it appeared, it caused a fight between dragons and tigers, leaving a legend of gods fighting for the sky.

    At the moment when the sun and the moon appeared together, the four continents and five seas of Huayang Continent were filled with uneasiness, excitement, and excitement. In this era when the gods were about to appear, everyone wanted to leave their own shadow in the legends that followed; everyone hoped that they could travel across the entire era and roam freely between heaven and earth.

    This is a great opportunity. I wonder who will have the last laugh? This is an endless killing. Who can escape from this boundless sea of ​​blood?

    But on this endless continent, not everyone cares so much whether this moment is the beginning or the end of a certain era, because there are too many things that are too important than these extremely distant and ethereal things, such as eating, dressing, and the inheritance of blood.

    Outside the gate of He Mansion in Yuanshan Town, Wu Dynasty, Huayang Continent, there were circles and circles of "Listening to Happy People", and the house was already decorated with lanterns. Although it was only dusk, the red lanterns were lit up early.

    Anyone who has been a father knows that giving birth to a child is something that cannot be rushed. No matter how anxious you are outside the door, there will still be nothing but heartbreaking cries of pain in the room.

    In the backyard, I could see the old woman and the maidservant coming and going in a hurry, but there was no sign of panic or noise, which showed that the discipline was usually very strict. However, another scream came from the house at this time. This made He Lie so anxious that he turned around countless times outside the door, sometimes with his hands behind his back and sometimes with fists. As they met, a sharp-edged, masculine face was covered with fine beads of sweat. He looked into the room from time to time. Although he had never given birth to a child, he knew that giving birth to a child was a completely hopeless battle with God, not only for the life of adults, but also for the lives of children.

    Looking at the busy people coming in and out, I kept mumbling: What are you people running around busy with? What's going on inside? Why hasn't it been born yet? It didn’t take me so long when I planted the seeds.

    Just when He Lie couldn't help but want to go in and see what was going on, an old woman came out and rushed towards He Lie. Seeing this situation, He Lie didn't know that she was looking for him? He hurriedly caught up and said without asking her to speak, "You're pregnant?" The old woman hurriedly shook her head and was about to speak when she saw the pain on He Lie's face. Her eyes instantly turned red. She clenched her fists and growled: "Bao Da! Hurry! Go quickly!"

    At this moment, a baby's cry came from the room. He Lie listened blankly to the baby's loud cry from the room. He doubted whether he heard it wrong, because he heard a cry. Until he saw a man running out of the house and shouted to him: "Master, it's a young master."

    Then there were sounds of congratulations and words of congratulations. Only then did he realize that this person just came to "hear the good news." It was like everyone in the house. Although the child had not been born yet, the red lanterns had already been hung high. Since then, the word "happiness" has been plastered everywhere in the house, which is called "Announcement of Good News". It is a celebration and auspicious. However, in my excitement, I lost my sense of proportion and couldn't help feeling embarrassed. I shouted: "Reward, everyone will be rewarded."
